name: Fakhruddin Ahmed
contribution: Fakhruddin Ahmed headed Bangladesh's military-backed caretaker government from 2007 to 2008 during a period of emergency rule and electoral preparation.
context: Bangladesh's 2007–08 political emergency, anti-corruption drive, and transition toward the December 2008 election.
impact: His tenure illustrates the tension between administrative reform, emergency governance, and the restoration of elected politics.
highlight: Fakhruddin Ahmed led Bangladesh's caretaker government during the 2007–08 emergency and transition to elections.
seoDescription: Explore Fakhruddin Ahmed's role as chief adviser during Bangladesh's 2007–08 emergency and electoral transition.
shortAnswer: Fakhruddin Ahmed was the chief adviser of Bangladesh's caretaker government during the 2007–08 emergency period.
